description.value: Wo Fung Noodle Express is a Chinese noodle restaurant in Richmond specializing in Hong Kong-style cart noodles (車仔麵), a customizable dish where diners choose noodle type and toppings. The Cantonese name 和豐車仔麵 places it squarely in the tradition of this beloved Hong Kong street-food format. It sits in Richmond's densely food-rich Park Road corridor, convenient for cyclists exploring the city's extensive flat bike network.
